[Gathered by ApprovalReady from official websites on 2026-10-12; a summary, not the source's wording] How to apply to ACT Government for a development application.
Planning scheme: Territory Plan.
Lodge (online): Lodge online through eDevelopment (ACT Planning) https://edevelopment.act.gov.au/SignIn.aspx?ReturnUrl=%2fdefault.aspx
Step 1: Look up your block on ACTmapi and check your crown lease.
Step 2: Check whether your work is exempt from a DA, or ask a building certifier.
Step 3: Book a free pre-lodgement meeting with the DA Gateway Team.
Step 4: Register for eDevelopment and lodge your DA with a Development Outcomes Report.
Step 5: Pay the fee once the DA passes the completeness check.
Pre-lodgement meetings: offered (Pre-lodgement meetings are free; written pre-application advice is charged.).
Phone: 13 22 81
Email: planningenquiries@act.gov.au
Hours: Customer Service Centre 02 6207 1923, 8:30am to 4:30pm Monday to Friday
Planning enquiries email: planningenquiries@act.gov.au
Planning enquiries phone: 02 6205 2888
Fee (2026-27): DA, cost up to $1,500: $147.02
Fee (2026-27): DA, $150,001 to $250,000: $1,121.36 plus 0.585% over $150,000
Fee (2026-27): DA, $250,001 to $500,000: $1,747.00 plus 0.438% over $250,000
Fee (2026-27): Exemption declaration, single dwelling: $728.96
Fee (2026-27): Lease variation: $2,732.33
Fee (2026-27): Pre-lodgement meeting: Free
